command:
set -uo pipefail
OMNI_KIT_ACCEPT_EULA=YES; ACCEPT_EULA=Y; PRIVACY_CONSENT=Y
export OMNI_KIT_ACCEPT_EULA ACCEPT_EULA PRIVACY_CONSENT
if [ -f /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libGLX_nvidia.so.0 ]; then LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libGLX_nvidia.so.0; export LD_PRELOAD; fi
ldconfig 2>/dev/null || true
echo "SMOKE_A_START $(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version,memory.total --format=csv,noheader
cd /workspace
t0=$(date +%s)
/isaac-sim/python.sh isaaclab_arena/evaluation/policy_runner.py --policy_type zero_action \
  --num_episodes 1 --num_envs 1 --seed 100 --headless --enable_cameras \
  put_item_in_fridge_and_close_door --embodiment gr1_joint > /tmp/smokeA.log 2>&1
rc=$?
grep -vE "^\s*$" /tmp/smokeA.log | tail -80
echo "SMOKE_A_EXIT rc=$rc seconds=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))"
exit $rc
